title: Geodesic-informed neural networks for testing spacetimes with S2
summary: Across five tested alternatives, the fit improvement over Schwarzschild did not offset the evidence penalty. The reported log Bayes factors span approximately -3.4 to -0.8 for the stated priors and dataset. Verified against an exact numerical solver and checked posterior approximation in appendices. The authors used existing observations without the newer GRAVITY astrometry; prior choices and data precision limit conclusions.
ai_technology: A trained geodesic-informed differentiable network represented each orbit to fit published S2 astrometry and line-of-sight velocities and obtain likelihood derivatives for model comparison.
organization: Department of Physics, University of Waterloo, Waterloo, Ontario, Canada
